in_marathi.name: Kiranshree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rays of Goddess Shree
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kiranshree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kiranshree is a beautiful and meaningful name derived from the Sanskrit language. The name Kiran means 'ray of light' or 'rays of God', and Shree is the Goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. Therefore, Kiranshree symbolizes the radiance and blessings of Goddess Shree. This name is often given to a baby girl to bless her with the light of knowledge, prosperity, and good fortune throughout her life.
